newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's LG-Caltex to invest 10 trln won by 2005.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's LG-Caltex to invest 10 trln won by 2005.

text.p: South Korea's LG-Caltex Oil Corp said on Tuesday it would invest 10 trillion won by the year 2005 to become one of the world's leading oil and petrochemical companies.
A company statement said the 10 trillion won would be spent to expand and upgrade facilities, as well as to develop alternative energy.

Upgrading facilities would include 50,000 barrel-per-day (bpd) heavy oil hydro cracker, 10,000-bpd alkylation plant, 30,000-bpd gasoline desulphuriser, 60,000-bpd diesel desulphuriser and 60,000-bpd heavy oil desulphuriser.
The company did not give a detailed time frame.
LG-Caltex is a joint venture between LG Group and Caltex Petroleum Corp, itself a joint venture between U.S. oil giants Texaco Inc and Chevron Corp.
LG-Caltex is the nation's second largest refiner with a refining capability of 600,000 bpd.
